extracted.intended_audience: general users who need to convert lengths from centimeters to feet (online/tool users)
extracted.subtask_description: Provide an online centimeter→feet length conversion (calculator and lookup table) with unit definitions and selectable decimal-place rounding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion factor (cm → ft)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the numeric conversion constant used to compute results shown in the calculator and table; many table entries are shown rounded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decimal places / Rounding
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User may select the number of decimal places (or Auto) to control how the converted result is rounded in display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unit definitions and abbreviations
rubrics_metrics.description: Centimeter: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter. There are 2.54 centimeters in an inch. Abbreviation: cm. Foot: a unit equal to exactly 12 inches or 0.3048 meters. Abbreviation: ft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeters-to-feet conversion table
rubrics_metrics.description: A lookup table showing cm → ft conversions for many sample centimeter values (from 0.1 up through at least 10,000), with values shown (often rounded).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table entries note that results may be rounded and an 'inverse table' option is provided.
